title: S. Korean military, UNC conduct preparation for DMZ explosion probe

blocks.text: South Korean military and the United Nations Command on Saturday conducted a preparatory inspection as the onsite investigation into the cause of the blast in the Demilitarized Zone earlier this week. Some 20 troops led by Lt. Gen. Kwon Dae-won, a vice chair of the Joint Chiefs of Staff who leads a task force for a joint investigation, as well as a UNC colonel, was dispatched Saturday to the site near the explosion.
